who: Maintainers reviewing public bug reports need an executable reproducer without giving an agent access to their workstation or long-lived credentials.
agent_work: The agent inspects a pinned repository inside a Celesto Cloud computer, writes a minimal regression test, and submits it for an independent buggy-versus-fixed execution check.
proof_output: A generated regression test, real command stdout/stderr and exit codes, a bimodal verdict, a trusted run-ledger row, and append-only command and failure traces.
